Updated for queued follow-up files. Traced: inboxFollowUpOf admits files when storeQueuedAttachment exists (filesQueueable); the queue closure writes bytes via EventStore.storeQueuedAttachmentBlob and accepts or releases the stage on queued or not; ThreadInboxPayload.attachments {kind,name,mimeType,size,blobRef} enter the entry digest and decode strictly; the projection lists descriptors only; inboxPlacementStartPort reads them back via readQueuedAttachmentFrom and refuses attachment_unavailable; followUpAttachments is withdrawn on hosted; the UI gates the composer and the send guard on it. Route, composer and messaging tests with fault injection cover it.
